h1: Shopify Product Photos for Pages, Grids and Clips
lead: You can show the product in a room you never rented, then download the Shopify product photo and place it on the page.
card: Shopify product photos, new backgrounds, and short videos, made one by one or many at a time.
secondary_keywords: product photos for a Shopify store

faq.q: What does this photo tool make for a store?
faq.a: It builds a Shopify product photo from a picture you already shot, so the product page can go up without a location day.

faq.q: How does a Shopify picture get made?
faq.a: Upload the product and say where you want it, such as on a bench. You get a file back, and you can ask for more light before you download.

faq.q: Which photo tool should a Shopify store use?
faq.a: Use one that can restage your real product, hold a consistent look, and hand you a file you upload yourself. The finished file is ready for your store. We do not rank ourselves against other tools.

faq.q: Can I make these photos without paying?
faq.a: No. Every photo spends credits on a paid monthly plan. Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits, Pro is $35 for 300, and Premium is $63 for 600. There is no zero-cost way to run a photo.

faq.q: Do these photos belong on a store?
faq.a: Yes. The same product photo can sit on the Shopify page and in a paid post. You spend credits, not a location fee.

faq.q: What does a Shopify product photo tool create?
faq.a: You get another scene when the collection needs one, and you can take the old background off a phone photo before that scene is made.

faq.q: Can I use the photos in public?
faq.a: Yes. The download can go on the product page and in your ads. If a form asks who owns the file, the answer is in the terms you accepted with the plan.

faq.q: What should the upload look like?
faq.a: Start with a clear, well-lit photo of the whole item. [how to take product photos for AI](/guides/product-photo-tips) shows what kind of photo works.

faq.q: Can I refresh a whole collection together?
faq.a: Yes. Run many products in one batch so the grid shares a look. Each file spends credits, and the cost shows before you start. If a job fails, those credits come back.

more_sections.h2: Shopify Product Photos a Page Can Use
more_sections.lead: A collection tile, a scene, and a Shopify product video are separate downloads.

items.d: You get the whole product, square, with nothing fighting it. Use this as the image in the collection.
The gallery frame shows the product in a real seat, not on the white sweep used in the grid. Shoppers see the size against something familiar.
Turn the still into a 6, 10, 15, or 30 second clip and add that Shopify product video on the page. A video spends 24, 40, 60, or 120 credits.

benefits_lead: One photo is enough for the next tile on the Shopify collection grid.

reasons.h2: Why Stores Make Product Photos Without a Shoot
reasons.lead: The next product photo does not need a location scout.

items.d: A product photo is 24 credits. The charge appears before you start, so you can budget the images you were going to reshoot.
You can upload tonight and put a file on the product page, even when the photographer's next open morning is weeks out.
Generate Shopify product photos for many products together when the grid needs a refresh. It is closer to restocking the page than booking another location.
The new Shopify photo can show the product over a wooden chair you never bought, and nobody has to be booked to sit in it.
You can export a new Shopify product photo late at night, after the orders are packed, when the studio you used to rent is closed.
You can keep the Shopify photo that matches the collection. Make one frame in a dim room and one in a bright hallway, then pick.
